data.title: 白面鸮 · 彩色索引
data.description: 她将不同颜色的标签贴到对应文件上，检查顺序后，把整摞资料移回书架。
data.camera: 中近景，文件与标签清晰
data.promptProse: Seated at an orderly archive workstation, Ptilopsis meticulously attaches color-coded index tabs along the margins of thick research dossiers. Highlighters, document trays, and classified file binders are arranged in perfect geometric symmetry under bright overhead lighting.
data.animaCaption: Pressing a bright adhesive tab firmly along the dossier's spine, she verifies the filing index code before sorting the next folder.
